tools.name: search_coupons
tools.description: Find current coupon codes and deals (offers without a code, e.g. free shipping) by keyword and/or store name, optionally for one country. A keyword also matches store names, so "vpn" finds NordVPN. Returns up to 10 active offers (at most 3 per store unless a store is given) with code (or none), end

tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Find stores by name or domain. Returns up to 10 stores with their number of current offers and links, and says when there are more.

tools.name: get_store_offers
tools.description: List one store's current coupon codes and deals, soonest ending first, optionally for one country. Returns up to 10 offers with code (or none), end date, countries and links, plus the store's total number of offers and a link to all of them on Coupossum.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find individual products currently on sale by keyword, optionally with a maximum price, currency and country. Returns up to 10 products with sale price, regular price, ship-to countries and links, and says when there are more. Covers products on sale, not coupon codes.
